title: Dow slumps over 1% at close as hawkish Fed minutes outweigh Nvidia optimism; Anthropic reveals IPO price: Stock Market Highlights - The Economic Times
text: Dow Jones | Nasdaq | Stock Market Live: The S&P 500 and Dow Jones tumble on Wednesday even as Nvidia’s upbeat revenue forecast eases concerns about the chipmaker’s outlook and lifts sentiment toward AI-linked stocks.
